Hello! 
I would like to see an image of ヘラジカ from けものフレンズ in your style.
I would enjoy it if she were wearing equipment that feels like what a low level adventurer would have, similar to the idea for https://skeb.jp/@Akina021/works/29 
In this image, she has a confident expression.
While it does not have to be exactly the same, I would enjoy something inspired by the feeling of this armor design https://files.catbox.moe/edx4rz.png 
Rather than being designed to be practical like the armor in the other request, the clothing has a feeling somewhat like a sporty outfit (such as a sports bra and spats) paired together with light and asymmetrical metal armor. Due to her confident nature, she wears something that shows off her powerful and attractive body rather than wearing something with good protection. 
For equipment, I think it would be nice for her to have a simple but powerful looking spear along with some other items you might see a low level warrior using in a fantasy setting.
If possible, I would love it if you could include a variant where she wears a long cloak over her shoulders. 
Additionally, if possible I would like to see a variant including battle damage on her clothes to show off her body and a slightly worried look on her face. 
Any other details are fine.
Thank you!

初めまして、Akinaさん。skebで拝見したキャラデザインのイラストがとても良かったので、自分も私宅のオリジナルキャラの強化形態(変身形態)のキャラデザインをお願いたしくリクエストを送らせていただきました。

・金銭的に可能でしたら、背面図もお願いします
